H01.description: An arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true but lacks eval_only: true is silently counted as a decision component instead of being refused or treated as evaluation-only.

H02.description: The report silently drops eval-only arms from the component count without disclosing which arms were excluded or how many rows they carried.

H03.description: Renders the new eval-only arms line in the Markdown report.

H04.description: Adds the eval-only arm counts to the JSON report.

H05.description: Header comment updated to mention the oracle_open toggle.

H06.description: The eval_only refusal keys only on the eval_only flag, so an arm with toggles.oracle_open: true (or a non-boolean eval_only/oracle_open read as false) runs the open-mount oracle outside the batch context.

H07.description: Adds an assertion for the eval-only arms line.

H08.description: Adds a test that the report refuses an oracle_open arm without eval_only.

H09.description: Adds tests for oracle_open-derived eval_only refusal and non-boolean type checks.

I01.description: KF-049 describes the earlier open-mount oracle exposure that the cycle-131 closed mount at head already addresses; the open mount remains only as the intended eval-only control.

I02.description: Refusal fallback to Opus is documented as designed behaviour and is flagged as degraded; not a defect in the head code.
